title: PlaneMem session command identity, ordinary start and original start receipt
description: Source-only complete public success contracts. Ordinary start returns current session plus immutable original receipt; lookup returns only historical observation. Command identity describes current verified claims, not project existence or future authorization. Register session-activity-read.json locally.
$comment: Runtime additionally checks exact original field presence/values, scope/actor/client/trace, real dates, current-versus-receipt relationships and source equality. UTF-16 bounds differ from JSON Schema scalar lengths. No validator/generator, SDK/Mock machine-contract integration or execution evidence.

key.$comment: validateIdempotencyKey accepts 1..255 UTF-16 non-whitespace units, not ASCII-only. No additional control/DEL/lone-surrogate restriction in this key parser.

time.$comment: Runtime requires finite Date.parse and exact toISOString roundtrip. Original start/closure may use year0000; command identity expiry separately excludes it. No extended years.

sources.description: Wire start preserves stored source extensions. Runtime requires at least one {type:'session',id:original client_id}, not new session_id. No duplicate rejection or source visibility/existence/length checks. Outer and inner sources are the same saved array.

clientSource.description: SDK parseSessionStartEnvelope strips source extensions and compares normalized outer/inner arrays in order; does not deduplicate.

contextPermissions.description: read=admin or context.read; write=admin or session.write; claim=write or handoff.claim. At least one true and write implies claim; write need not imply read. Flags do not evaluate project visibility, future Policy/OPA or record state.

contextEnvelope.description: Exact current trace (<=512 UTF-16, no controls/DEL/lone surrogates) and scope. Full candidate JSON.stringify UTF-8<=16KiB. Handler requires verified client with finite future token expiry; shared parser alone checks representation, not Date.now. SDK checks expiry and optional actor/client after reading. No business record lookup, ETag or original request key.

command.description: Original optional fields, including whether each was supplied, must be retained. Explicit actor/client must equal verified identity; empty object is valid. Never inject current IDs into an originally absent field.

body.description: Raw JSON object. Stable key required in Idempotency-Key header or this body field; if both supplied they must match. Business command excludes the key. All versions/resume_origin/other fields rejected; no implicit parent default.

query.description: Original raw key and exact original optional business fields, not current session metadata or a new request. Current verified actor/client/scope bind the lookup; no write headers.

binding.description: Local SDK/recovery binding, not an HTTP body. Identity exactly matches original scope and explicit optional actor/client; supplied instance actor/client must agree.

recorded.description: Immutable minimal original start receipt. Exact original parent presence/value and actor/client; new session_id differs from parent. session_version always1 even after current session advances. No trace/scope/key/fingerprint/source fields inside receipt.

lookup.description: not-observed describes no matching dedicated receipt in the authorized SQL snapshot; may include legacy records without this receipt. Does not prove failure/rollback or permit new-key retry.

current.description: Current durable session plus original receipt, not a historical version1 snapshot. Runtime enforces matching receipt/session ID, parent presence/value, actor/client and started_at, exact scope, no resume_origin and terminal ended_at>=started_at. Current trace can differ from outer request trace and original creation trace after later writes. Wire source extensions retained. No total response byte bound.

startEnvelope.description: Built-in HTTP commandResult output has current outer trace and saved inner sources; no ETag/outer revision/identity hints. Outer trace uses generic request selection without the SDK's stricter <=1024 name check. Server source arrays preserve extensions. Only complete durable result is successful, but an error after commit does not establish rollback.

receiptEnvelope.description: Read-only HTTP result: current trace, empty sources and no ETag/current session body. Shared SDK parser additionally validates trace as <=1024 UTF-16 name; server command route does not apply that full envelope parser.

etag.description: Optional parser compatibility only; built-in start handler emits no ETag. If supplied, decoded version must be a safe integer equal to current data.version; leading zeros accepted.

clientEnvelope.description: Separate normalized SDK success shape; exact current trace/original binding and normalized source equality, strips extensions/unknown fields. No independent bounded transport or timeout/signal option for start/receipt methods.
